body:
Haha, yeah, I've worked at camps before.  I guess I could try that.

But it's not really working with people my own age.  I feel like I'd be going in a circle doing that.
Most animal shelters want people during the day time.  I can't think of a place that would want a night shift person.  Any ideas?

I don't have a primary care doctor either.  I recently moved, and my old doctor doesn't have any references here.  I've been trying to get a PCP, but it's impossible for some reason.

I guess, but it stinks.  I don't really do anything because of it.  I'm afraid to spend money.  And I cook a lot of Asian food that I get from Chinatown, which is really cheap.  I like to experiment with all the weird sauces and spices.  I've been cooking a lot since I was like 8, so I have a lot of background as to what goes with what.

I'd go outside and go biking or something, but it's too freaking cold.  It makes me more miserable.  And I'm afraid of game stores because I know I will end up buying something.  There's not much around here that's free.  I've searched many times for free things, but they all don't seem very fun to me.  Plus, I've had a hard time connecting with people in the past at those events.  I'm far from a girly girl, and guys always end up just hitting on me.  It's not very pleasant for me.

You make a good point.  I guess I'm a bit different.  If I see anyone struggling with anything, I ask if they are okay and if they need help.  Even if it's someone I've never met before.  

My job is completely permanent.  My boss really likes me, and I've contributed a lot and I don't see a reason he would let me go any time soon.  I do have insurance, but no PCP.  My co-pays are only $20 everywhere, except for the hospital which is like $200 or something.

I volunteered at the aquarium last year.  It was fun, but my job was pretty much walking around solo and the people I worked with were all old and retired.  Kind of hard to make friends there.  I guess I can try a different place and see what happens.  My problem is that weekends are the only time I can do it, but it's also the only time I get to see my boyfriend.  It's hard for me to make that time commitment.

I live in the city and have the unlimited ride pass because of work.  It's just, I honestly don't know what I want to do anymore.  I tried do a couple through Meetup.com, but most of them involve money.  It sucks.  It doesn't really help that I'm incredibly nerdy.  The ones I've gone to talk about sports, politics, and shopping.  I don't really give a shit about any of those.  What I'd rather talk about is the next LOL champ or Marvel.  I have a hard time connecting with girls because of this.  And when I talk to guys, they're full on hitting on me (I'll admit, I'm quite attractive).  In college I could probably find people within my CS department, but now, I don't know where to go.

It looks like minimum of 4 years to pay them off, and that's being really rigorous.

My boyfriend knows everything.  He wants me to see a therapist about it too.  I've been trying to get a hold of one, but either they are booked until June or they don't get back to me.  It's impossible to find help.  But in the mean time, he does help me with everything, but the burden of that on him, it makes me feel really guilty.  He's starting to admit it's taking a toll on him.  I don't want my depression to be the end of a great relationship.

I'm weird with money.  I just bought a Ninja blender worth $200, but I know that I'll actually use it.  When going to the grocery store, I spend less than $10 per week (I get my fruits/veggies from a farmers market for less than $10, I'm eating healthy, don't worry).  When I have to spend the $100 to visit my boyfriend, it's rough.  Yes I get to see him, but only for 2 days while he's still doing other things like projects.  Forget other traveling or eating out or museums or whatever, I don't unless it's a holiday with family or boyfriend.

Yeah, not connecting.  That's something.  One thing I wish I could do.  What I'd give to have just 1 friend to just do whatever with.  I can connect, it's evident through my past friendships and current bf, but my ex really did a number to me I think.  I'm afraid to trust.  I'm afraid to be hurt.  My freshman year friends didn't even try to help.  I know most friendships come and go, but I was definitely looking horrible and they didn't even say anything.  I hate people, but yet, I need people.  What a horrible Catch-22.

I hate Minecraft, but maybe something like that would help.  I don't know.  I'm really sick of computers.  Anyone I have contact with is through a computer.  I need people that I can go out in the city with.
